name: Marius Alexandr
bio:
Marius Alexandr is a tattoo artist renowned for his mastery in black&gray ink, crafting each piece with a deeply ingrained philosophy that art is a permanent essence not suited for the fickle hearted. Operating out of El Gordo Tattoo Shop in Oviedo, Asturias, Marius exudes professionalism in his approach to his craft, inviting patrons into a world where tattoos are more than mere images, but rather lifelong companions. His dedication to cleanliness ensures each client's experience is not only artistically fulfilling but also held to the highest standards of hygiene and care.
